items.title: Jean Bach interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: John Kirby’s band... Charlie Shavers wrote the arrangements and played trumpet... The cast was Russell Procope... Billy Kyle was the piano player... Kirby was the bassist.

ctx.x: Once they were on stage, it was okay, but “come in the back door.”

Yeah. It’s terrible. So I guess I did all my listening on their turf. Well, no, oh, John Kirby’s band played in the Pump Room of the Ambassador East Hotel, which was then the toniest hotel in Chicago. Beautiful. And the room was exquisite, with dark blue walls and white woodwork, and sconces and it was very stylish. And they’d had a lot of good bands in there — Teddy Wilson was there and at any rate, when Kirby played, they looked so marvelous. They had tail suits, full dress suits, but everything was in white.…
Who were some of your favorite characters, players, in the Basie groups over the years?
